column1: # The family runs (store/family_runs/known-2026-10-29.tsv) the Rust host refuses on two vCPUs, held there by name to the refusal (Sprint 351): family, run, the stop w2m-vm --vcpus 2 writes. Two refusals: a run that starts a child process, refused until the Machine has its own thread, the run-loop design's card 4f (crates/w2m_vm/src/host_request.rs MACHINE_ON_ONE; Sprint 325); and a run whose family starts on the instruction clock, refused before any VM (crates/w2m_vm/src/run.rs vcpus_allowed; Sprint 315) until the instruction clock's own card, its refusal written as the run's stop by w2m-vm. Each conforms on one vCPU. Held by crates/w2m_vm/tests/family_runs.rs, which fails a run listed here that stops otherwise, a run not listed that stops so, and a stop here that is neither refusal
